meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行 git 提交、整理提交记录与搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果管理代码提交、整理提交记录或追溯历史修改是你的日常。
copy.tagline_en: Commit code, organize commit history, and search past changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often commit code, organize commit history, or search past changes.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先判断你的 Git 请求属于“提交、rebase/squash、查历史”哪一类,再走对应流程。默认会把多个文件按目录和逻辑拆成多个原子提交,并沿用仓库现有提交风格,而不是一个大提交。
howto.when: 当你说到 “commit”“rebase/squash” 等词,或问某段代码是谁写的、某个改动是什么时候加的时候,会触发。

say.text: 帮我按业务逻辑把这 8 个改动拆成多个提交。
say.note: 它会先输出提交计划,再分别提交。

say.text: 我想把最近几个提交 squash 成一个。
say.note: 进入 rebase 模式,帮你合并提交。

say.text: 这个文件里的函数是什么时候加的?
say.note: 会查 log -S,给出引入该改动的提交。

howto.what_en: After loading, Claude detects a git request as commit, rebase/squash, or history search and follows that workflow. It splits multi-file changes into atomic commits by directory/logic, matching the repo's commit style, instead of one big commit.
howto.when_en: It triggers when you mention keywords like 'commit', 'rebase/squash', ask who wrote a piece of code, when something was added, or to find the commit that introduced something.

say_en.text: Please split these 8 changes into several commits by business logic.
say_en.note: It prints a commit plan first, then commits separately.

say_en.text: I'd like to squash my last few commits into one.
say_en.note: It enters rebase mode and merges them.

say_en.text: When was the function in this file added?
say_en.note: It searches log -S and shows the introducing commit.
